nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model Robust Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level Huber, Quantile, and RANSAC estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above SciPy optimizer, SciPy linear-programming, and estimator-callback boundaries.

nodes.name: robust_linear_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public robust linear-model estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: robust_linear_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return the robust estimator family represented by a public estimator name.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a dictionary lookup over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: robust_linear_estimator_boundary
nodes.description: Return the optimizer or callback boundary selected by a public robust estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: robust_linear_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level robust estimator routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public-method tuple for each covered estimator.

nodes.name: robust_linear_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public robust estimator fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing optimizer or estimator callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, sample_weight: object = None, fit_params: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and sample weights, then packages references without fitting.

nodes.name: robust_linear_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public robust estimator prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction or scoring to sklearn.

nodes.name: robust_linear_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public robust estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: robust_linear_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted coefficient, inlier, skip-count, and boundary metadata after deferred robust-estimator execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes fitted arrays and scalar metadata already produced by sklearn fitting, counting outlier or inlier masks when present.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 2 and Case 3 public robust/LP/meta-estimator shells over SciPy optimizer and estimator-callback boundaries
limitations: The internal fitted-state topology is obscured by SciPy L-BFGS-B, SciPy linprog, and arbitrary estimator-callback boundaries.

The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not optimizer convergence, LP solve behavior, RANSAC sampling, consensus-loop execution, validation execution, prediction, or scoring internals.
